notes: BUDGET PAGE: one-time expenses now get real budget tubes, one per planned item. Previously the Budget page carried a single 'One-time expenses' row with an allotted amount hard-coded to zero, so any spend read as fully over and went red — even when the month had a planned amount sitting in inputs. The row also only appeared once money had been spent, so a planned trip was invisible until the first payment. NOW, for a month with planned one-offs, each plan renders as its own tube with its own allotted amount, exactly as EMIs do: 'Diwali Trip  Rs 45.0K / Rs 80.0K  56%'. Spend claimed against a plan only turns red once it exceeds that plan (Rs 95,000 against Rs 80,000 shows 119%, red). Spending with nothing planned behind it collects into an 'Unplanned one-time' row that keeps the original zero-budget behaviour, so it reads as over at any amount. A 'One-time · total' master row appears only when there is more than one line above it to total. A planned item with nothing spent yet now shows as Rs 0 of its plan rather than being hidden, which is what makes the budget visible before the spending starts. UNPLANNED MONTHS UNCHANGED, as intended: with nothing planned, the single row behaves exactly as before — Rs 1 against Rs 0 reads 'over budget' and fills red. DRILL-DOWN: tapping a plan's row lists only the transactions linked to that plan; tapping 'Unplanned one-time' lists only the unlinked ones. A transaction whose linked plan has since been deleted is treated as unplanned here too, matching how the projection sheet handles it, so logged money is never orphaned out of view. VERIFIED across four cases: two plans with partial spend plus unplanned spending (Rs 45.0K/Rs 80.0K, Rs 14.0K/Rs 14.0K, Rs 5.0K unplanned over, Rs 64.0K/Rs 94.0K total); overspend (Rs 95.0K/Rs 80.0K, 119%, red); nothing planned with Rs 1 spent (over budget, red); and a plan with no spend yet (Rs 0/Rs 80.0K). Drill-down filters confirmed to separate linked from unlinked transactions correctly. No page errors. BUILDS ON v2026.05.07.01, which introduced stable ids on one-off entries, the journal's 'Counts towards' picker, actual-of-planned on the projection sheet, and the fix for repeating one-offs being double-counted in their own month. Engine, runProjection, the live-anchored EOM savings fix and the Decisions tab are all untouched.
